data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 recorded a material release of prior year gross claims reserves in 2015: gross claims outstanding reduced from GBP 27.796m at the start of the year to GBP 13.540m at year end, driven by a gross prior-year release of GBP 30.753m. The movement is reported as favourable claims development on prior years (release). The syndicate writes non-marine treaty reinsurance (quota-share on Syndicate 33 property catastrophe), and the prior year improvement reflects favourable development on older catastrophe estimates (including modest reductions related to Japanese earthquake and Thai floods as noted).
raw_causal_phrases: The old years' release of GBP 0.7 million benefited from modest reductions in the loss estimates for the Japanese earthquake and Thai floods.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) taken from the technical provisions movement table (Change in prior year provisions). The report also references an 'old years' release of GBP 0.7m related to reductions in Japanese earthquake and Thai floods estimates (mentioned in the underwriting account narrative) but the principal quantified gross movement for 2015 is -GBP 30.753m. Claims development triangle is available (gross) and was not used to recalculate the PYD because the movement table explicitly reports the gross prior-year change. Some named events are referenced without precise years or quantified amounts in the 2015 notes.
